import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# We'll fetch multiple pages until we have 5 relevant papers
def fetch_arxiv_page(start_index):
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'  # already encoded
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start_index}&max_results=25&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    return web_fetch(url=url)

# Namespace for parsing
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

papers_collected = []
start = 0
max_pages = 5  # we'll check up to 5 pages (125 papers)

while len(papers_collected) < 5 and start < max_pages * 25:
    result = fetch_arxiv_page(start)
    if result.get('status') != 200:
        print(f"Failed to fetch page starting at {start}")
        break
    
    root = ET.fromstring(result['content'])
    entries = root.findall('atom:entry', ns)
    
    for entry in entries:
        # Extract basic info
        title_elem = entry.find('atom:title', ns)
        summary_elem = entry.find('atom:summary', ns)
        updated_elem = entry.find('atom:updated', ns)
        id_elem = entry.find('atom:id', ns)
        
        if None in (title_elem, summary_elem, updated_elem, id_elem):
            continue
            
        title = title_elem.text.strip()
        summary = ' '.join(summary_elem.text.strip().split())
        updated = updated_elem.text.strip()
        arxiv_id = id_elem.text.strip()
        
        # Get the HTML link
        link = None
        for link_elem in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
            if link_elem.get('rel') == 'alternate' and link_elem.get('type') == 'text/html':
                link = link_elem.get('href')
                break
        
        # Relevance filter: look for multimodal/vision/etc in title or summary
        text_lower = (title + ' ' + summary).lower()
        multimodal_indicators = [
            'multimodal', 'vision', 'visual', 'image', 'video', 
            'audio', 'speech', 'crossmodal', 'cross-modal', 
            'vlm', 'vision-language', 'vision language',
            'video', 'audio', 'speech', 'graph', 'document',
            'table', 'chart', 'figure', 'illustration'
        ]
        
        if any(indicator in text_lower for indicator in multimodal_indicators):
            papers_collected.append({
                'title': title,
                'summary': summary,
                'date': updated[:10],  # just YYYY-MM-DD
                'link': link,
                'id': arxiv_id
            })
            
            if len(papers_collected) >= 5:
                break
    
    start += 25  # next page

print(f"Found {len(papers_collected)} relevant papers:")
for i, p in enumerate(papers_collected, 1):
    print(f"\n{i}. {p['title']}")
    print(f"   arXiv: {p['id']}")
    print(f"   Date: {p['date']}")
    print(f"   Link: {p['link']}")
    print(f"   Summary: {p['summary'][:200]}...")
